blocks.text: CORON, Palawan – Weeks after flames engulfed the MV June Aster, leaving dozens dead and several others still missing, grieving families finally came face-to-face with the stricken vessel on Friday, reaching the site to pray, remember their loved ones and begin the painful process of healing.
